messages:
ravi s: quick flag 1: post-canary we observed ~0.3% failures in eu1 embeddings; root cause = quant/KV cache type mismatch. proposing an expedited hotfix in the late window.
jen (oncall): paste a tiny log snippet + rollback cmd pls. we need SRE ok.
ravi s: log: ```
ERROR embeddings-eu1: kvcache type mismatch id=0x4b7
```
rollback: `/deploy rollback embeddings-eu1 v2026-03-embed-77` or pin previous sha. perf impact minimal (~+0.2ms p50).
marco: SRE thresholds: compressed canary only. 5% for 4m smoke, 50% for 8m, then 100% if error <=0.4% and p95 within +10%. rollback if error >0.6% or cpu >75% sustained 2m.
jen (oncall): product signoff required; maria please confirm relnotes ready.
ravi s: relnotes stub ready and linked in PR: https://go/relnotes/PR-1601. includes revert steps.
release-bot: Deployment request created by ravi s for service=embeddings-eu1 version=v2026-03-hotfix-58 image=sha256:deadbeef. Approvers notified.
ravi s: launching expedited deploy:```
/deploy embeddings-eu1 v2026-03-hotfix-58 --pin --expedite --canary=5% --smoke=4m
```
release-bot: canary started at 5912349998. logs: https://go/logs/deploy/5912349990
marco: 4m canary: error rate 0.02%, p95 +0.1ms. green. ramping to 50%.
ravi s: bump to 50% now.
release-bot: 50% ramp at 5912350015.
marco: 6m into 50%: error 0.05%, latency stable. proceeding to 100% over 6m.
release-bot: final ramp complete at 5912350024. traffic=100%.
jen (oncall): marking expedited approval here. rollback command above. watching for 30m.
ravi s: thanks all  will open follow-up if anything. :thumbsup:
